name: search_my_videos
description: Search the authenticated author's non-deleted video metadata by literal title and publication dates. Results are candidates, not authorization to analyze. When selection_required=true, ask_clarification must select the target. For metadata listing alone, return candidates without forcing selection. Never claim contents were watched.

query.description: Literal title text; omit to list videos by date. Do not include action words such as analyze.

start_date.description: Inclusive publication date in Asia/Shanghai. Supply with end_date.

end_date.description: Exclusive publication date in Asia/Shanghai. Supply with start_date.

offset.description: Zero-based candidate offset; continue using next_offset.

limit.description: Maximum candidates per page, from 1 to 20; default 10.
